cofounder_conflict_desc: Your co-founder wants to pivot the company. They feel the current market is too saturated and thinks you've been building the wrong thing for 3 months.
cofounder_conflict_choice_0: Stay the course — your vision is correct
server_outage_desc: Your cloud provider goes down during a critical marketing launch. 40% of users can't access the product for 6 hours. Refund requests are flooding in.
server_outage_choice_1: Offer free credits to affected users
server_outage_choice_2: Suppress it — fix quietly and hope nobody noticed
viral_tweet_desc: A prominent tech influencer tweeted about your product calling it 'the tool I've been waiting for'. You've had 10,000 signups in 24 hours.
viral_tweet_choice_1: Focus on stability: monitor servers first
viral_tweet_choice_2: Pitch the influencer for a partnership deal
talent_poaching_desc: A Big Tech company (Meta) is trying to poach your lead engineer with a 2.5× salary offer and $200K RSUs. They want an answer by Friday.
talent_poaching_choice_1: Offer a better role — convince them to stay
talent_poaching_choice_2: Wish them well and start hiring immediately
legal_threat_desc: A mystery shell company in Delaware claims your core feature infringes Patent #7,843,281 — filed in 2009. They want $200K to settle.
legal_threat_choice_1: Pay the settlement — not worth the fight
security_breach_desc: A hacker claims to have 5,000 user email addresses and hashed passwords. They're demanding $20K in crypto to stay quiet. You've confirmed the breach.
security_breach_choice_0: Full transparency: notify all users immediately
security_breach_choice_1: Patch quietly and force password resets
team_overworked_desc: Engineering has been pulling 80-hour weeks for 2 months. Three engineers are quietly browsing LinkedIn. Sprint velocity has dropped 40%.
team_overworked_choice_0: Cancel all non-essential projects for 2 weeks
team_overworked_choice_1: Give a surprise $2K bonus per person
employee_raise_demand_desc: Your senior engineer just slid a competing offer across the table — $30K more per year. They're giving you 48 hours.
employee_raise_demand_choice_1: Counter with a performance bonus plan
toxic_employee_desc: Your best salesperson is smashing quota but creating a hostile environment. Three employees have filed formal HR complaints. HR says act now.
remote_work_debate_desc: Half your team wants full remote. The other half demands an office for collaboration. A VP just threatened to quit if you don't decide by Monday.
team_offsite_desc: A boutique resort offers a 3-day corporate retreat package for $8K. The team hasn't had a team event in 18 months.
team_offsite_choice_0: Book it — team culture is the product
team_offsite_choice_2: Skip it — burn rate is too high
mass_resignation_desc: Three engineers have just handed in back-to-back resignation letters. They say compensation isn't competitive and there's no career growth visible.
mass_resignation_choice_1: Promote the remaining team + revamp roles
mass_resignation_choice_2: Accept it. Begin mass hiring immediately.
bad_hire_desc: Your new marketing hire's previous employer just called asking if they took proprietary client data when they left. They're now on your team.
culture_recognition_desc: A tech publication is profiling your company as one of the top startups to work for in the region. They want a feature interview.
culture_recognition_choice_2: Request they wait till after the product launch
competitor_price_war_desc: A well-funded competitor just slashed their prices by 40% and is running aggressive ads targeting your exact customer segments.
copycat_launch_desc: A well-resourced startup just launched what is clearly a clone of your product. They have $5M raised, a bigger team, and aggressive marketing.
copycat_launch_choice_0: Ship features faster — widen the moat
copycat_launch_choice_1: Focus on brand and community loyalty
industry_award_desc: You've been nominated for 'Best Startup of the Year' at a major tech conference gala. Winning requires schmoozing and a $3K table sponsorship.
industry_award_choice_0: Attend and campaign hard for the win
economic_downturn_desc: The economy is tightening. Investors are pulling back, SaaS churn is up 30% industry-wide, and customers are asking for discounts to renew.
economic_downturn_choice_0: Survival mode: cut all non-essential spend
economic_downturn_choice_2: Pivot to SMB — they're still spending
platform_policy_change_desc: Apple has changed App Store review policies. Your app's primary feature violates the new guidelines. You have 30 days to comply or get delisted.
platform_policy_change_choice_2: Launch a web version as a fallback
api_shutdown_desc: A third-party API your product is built on just announced they're shutting down in 60 days with no replacement guidance.
api_shutdown_choice_1: Migrate to a competing API ($3K integration)
api_shutdown_choice_2: Notify users and give them a credit
cloud_bill_spike_desc: Your AWS bill just tripled from $2K to $6K due to a viral usage spike from an unexpected source. Optimization is needed immediately.
cloud_bill_spike_choice_1: Negotiate an enterprise contract with AWS
cloud_bill_spike_choice_2: Absorb the cost — growth means profit soon
competitor_funding_desc: Your main competitor just announced a $20M Series A. They'll be 3× outspending you on marketing and hiring in the next quarter.
competitor_funding_choice_0: Accelerate your own raise timeline immediately
competitor_funding_choice_1: Find your niche — avoid direct competition
competitor_funding_choice_2: Stay the course — product quality wins
investor_ghosting_desc: A partner at a top-tier VC said 'let's move forward' after your pitch 3 weeks ago. They've now stopped responding to all emails and calls.
investor_ghosting_choice_0: Send a polite final follow-up and move on
investor_ghosting_choice_1: Ask a mutual connection for an introduction
investor_ghosting_choice_2: Post a subtle 'excited about our next meeting' tweet
angel_investment_offer_desc: A successful founder angel wants to write a $50K check at a $1M cap SAFE. In exchange they want monthly updates and advisory access.
investor_update_missed_desc: You forgot to send the monthly investor update for 2 months. One investor just sent a terse email: 'We need to discuss your commitment to transparency.'
investor_update_missed_choice_0: Send a detailed catch-up update immediately
investor_update_missed_choice_1: Schedule a call to address it directly
investor_update_missed_choice_2: Blame it on being too busy building
down_round_pressure_desc: With 3 months runway left and no term sheets, your existing investors are offering a bridge at a 40% lower valuation than your last round. Pride vs survival.
down_round_pressure_choice_0: Accept the down round — survival matters
down_round_pressure_choice_1: Negotiate a flat round with warrants
down_round_pressure_choice_2: Aggressively cut costs to extend runway
product_hunt_launch_desc: Your product just hit #1 on Product Hunt with 1,200 upvotes. You're getting 500 sign-ups per hour and your servers are straining. The next 24 hours could define your brand.
product_hunt_launch_choice_0: Go live directly — absorb the traffic
product_hunt_launch_choice_1: Enable a waitlist and onboard in batches
product_hunt_launch_choice_2: Post a live update thread on Twitter as it unfolds
critical_bug_in_prod_desc: A payment processing bug has been corrupting transactions for 48 hours. $12,000 in duplicate charges have hit user accounts. The Twitter thread is going viral.
critical_bug_in_prod_choice_1: Fix and retroactively fix data — no public statement
tech_debt_crisis_desc: Your engineers say the codebase is 'unmaintainable.' Every new feature takes 3× as long to ship. A major refactor is needed but will take 6 weeks.
tech_debt_crisis_choice_1: Partial refactor — 2 weeks, reduce debt slowly
tech_debt_crisis_choice_2: Keep shipping — deal with debt later
ai_feature_opportunity_desc: GPT-4 API is now available. Competitors are scrambling to add AI features. Your CTO says you can ship an AI feature in 3 weeks for $15K compute budget.
ai_feature_opportunity_choice_0: Ship it ASAP — first mover advantage
ai_feature_opportunity_choice_1: Wait and build it right (6 weeks)
uptime_achievement_desc: You've just crossed 12 months of 99.9% uptime — a key enterprise buying criteria. Enterprise customers are now asking about your SLA documentation.
uptime_achievement_choice_0: Publish a formal SLA and pursue enterprise deals
uptime_achievement_choice_1: Announce it on social media for marketing
uptime_achievement_choice_2: Use it in press release to raise valuation
tax_audit_desc: The IRS has flagged your R&D tax credit claim from last year. An audit has been opened. Your accountant says it could take 6 months and cost $15K in fees.
tax_audit_choice_0: Hire a tax attorney, fight the claim
tax_audit_choice_2: Represent yourself — you have the documentation
gdpr_violation_desc: A user complaint has triggered a GDPR investigation in the EU. You're not fully compliant — no DPA agreement, no data deletion flow. Fine could be up to $50K.
gdpr_violation_choice_0: Hire a GDPR consultant and become compliant ($10K)
gdpr_violation_choice_2: Ignore — unlikely they'll pursue a startup
contract_dispute_desc: Your biggest enterprise customer ($8K/mo) is claiming the product doesn't meet SLA requirements and is withholding 3 months of payments.
contract_dispute_choice_0: Negotiate a credit and fix the SLA
contract_dispute_choice_1: Escalate to legal — enforce the contract
contract_dispute_choice_2: Offer a full refund and walk away
ip_registration_desc: Your attorney recommends filing a provisional patent on your core algorithm before competitors copy it. Cost: $8K for provisional + $25K for full.
ip_registration_choice_2: Skip — patents take too long to matter
regulatory_license_desc: Your FinTech feature requires an NBFC license to operate legally. The application process takes 4 months and costs $20K in legal fees.
regulatory_license_choice_1: Operate without it — you're small enough to fly under radar
regulatory_license_choice_2: Find a licensed partner to white-label through
relationship_strain_desc: Your partner says you work 90-hour weeks and they barely see you. They've given you an ultimatum — either make time for them or they're leaving. The stress is visible in your work.
relationship_strain_choice_0: Take a week off to reconnect
relationship_strain_choice_1: Hire a COO to take load off you
relationship_strain_choice_2: Ask for more time — company needs you now
health_scare_desc: You've been ignoring chest tightness for weeks. Your doctor ran tests — stress-induced, not cardiac. But you're ordered to reduce work hours immediately.
health_scare_choice_1: Delegate more to your team this month
health_scare_choice_2: Ignore it — deadlines don't care about health
family_obligation_desc: A family member is critically ill. You need to travel for 2 weeks. Your team is capable but hasn't run without you before.
family_obligation_choice_0: Go. Empower your team to lead.
family_obligation_choice_2: Stay — send support but can't leave right now
gym_habit_desc: A fitness coach friend offers to design a personalized morning routine. Just 45 minutes a day. You've gained 12kg since founding the company.
gym_habit_choice_2: No time for it right now
therapy_session_desc: Your co-founder and a mentor have both separately recommended you see a therapist. You've been snapping at your team and your anxiety has been high.
therapy_session_choice_0: Book a therapist. Mental health is critical.
therapy_session_choice_2: I'm fine. It's just startup stress.
mentor_dinner_desc: A highly successful second-time founder has offered to have dinner with you. They've exited two companies. The conversation could be invaluable.
mentor_dinner_choice_0: Accept and come prepared with questions
mentor_dinner_choice_1: Accept casually — just enjoy the meal
imposter_syndrome_desc: You're in a room full of Stanford MBAs and ex-Google engineers. You suddenly feel deeply out of place. A VC asks you a question about unit economics and you blank out.
imposter_syndrome_choice_0: Be honest about your background — authenticity is rare
imposter_syndrome_choice_1: Bluff through it and study harder tonight
imposter_syndrome_choice_2: Excuse yourself — this crowd isn't for you yet
social_isolation_desc: You realize you haven't seen friends outside of work in 3 months. Your social circle has shrunk to investors and employees. You feel increasingly alone.
social_isolation_choice_0: Plan a proper social weekend — no laptops
social_isolation_choice_1: Join a founder peer group for connection
social_isolation_choice_2: Push through — loneliness is part of the journey
press_feature_desc: TechCrunch wants to write a profile of your company. The reporter is thorough and will ask hard questions about your path to profitability.
press_feature_choice_1: Decline — not ready for the scrutiny
press_feature_choice_2: Do it but only answer safe questions
key_customer_churn_desc: Acme Corp, your largest customer at $15K/mo, has cancelled their membership. Their reason: 'We found a more complete solution at a lower price.'
key_customer_churn_choice_0: Schedule an exit interview to learn deeply
key_customer_churn_choice_1: Offer them a 50% discount to stay
key_customer_churn_choice_2: Accept and move on — learn from it
conference_speaking_desc: A major tech conference has offered you a keynote speaking slot in front of 2,000 attendees. You'd need to prepare for 2 weeks.
conference_speaking_choice_1: Accept but do a quick 15-min talk
media_scandal_desc: A disgruntled former employee posted a detailed expose of your company culture on Glassdoor. It's being shared on Twitter and HN.
media_scandal_choice_0: Respond publicly with facts and honesty
viral_product_review_desc: A YouTube creator with 800K subscribers just uploaded a 12-minute review of your product saying it 'changed how they work.' Comments section is exploding.
viral_product_review_choice_1: Amplify it across all your channels
viral_product_review_choice_2: Prepare servers first — plan for traffic spike
enterprise_inbound_desc: A Fortune 500 company has inbound-requested a demo. Potential deal size: $120K/year. Only problem — they need ISO 27001 certification you don't have.
enterprise_inbound_choice_1: Start the demo process anyway and buy time
pivot_pressure_desc: Two of your investors attended your board meeting and suggested pivoting entirely to B2B enterprise. They believe consumer is too hard to monetize.
pivot_pressure_choice_0: Follow investor advice — pivot to B2B
pivot_pressure_choice_1: Defend your current strategy with data
pivot_pressure_choice_2: Test B2B alongside consumer for one quarter
partnership_opportunity_desc: A market leader with 200K users wants to integrate your product into their platform. Revenue share: 30% of new users they send you. They want exclusivity.
international_expansion_desc: 30% of your signups are coming from India and Southeast Asia — markets where you have zero presence. Several reseller inquiries have arrived.
international_expansion_choice_1: Work with the resellers on commission basis
international_expansion_choice_2: Ignore international for now — focus on core market
nps_milestone_desc: Your quarterly NPS survey returned a score of 72 — world-class. Users are calling your product 'life-changing.' You can use this in all sales materials.
nps_milestone_choice_0: Feature it prominently on landing page
nps_milestone_choice_1: Share with investors in next update
nps_milestone_choice_2: Dig into the qualitative feedback to improve
mrr_milestone_desc: You've crossed your first $10K MRR. The team is ecstatic. A Hacker News post is trending with your story and 200 people are asking questions.
mrr_milestone_choice_0: Write a transparent public earnings post
first_enterprise_close_desc: After 3 months of back-and-forth, your first enterprise deal just closed at $50K ARR. The legal docs are signed. Wire is incoming.
first_enterprise_close_choice_0: Celebrate with the team and announce publicly
first_enterprise_close_choice_1: Treat it as validation — double down on enterprise sales
first_enterprise_close_choice_2: Use it as social proof to close 3 more
feature_idea_from_user_desc: A power user posted a detailed feature request thread that collected 400 comments and 800 upvotes. It's clearly something people desperately need.
feature_idea_from_user_choice_0: Ship it next sprint — customer obsession
feature_idea_from_user_choice_1: Add it to the roadmap officially
feature_idea_from_user_choice_2: Research if it should be a paid add-on
superuser_emerged_desc: 50 of your most engaged users have self-organized into a community Discord server with 800 members. They're creating tutorials and onboarding new users for you.
superuser_emerged_choice_0: Invest in the community ($2K/mo community manager)
superuser_emerged_choice_2: Let it grow organically — don't interfere
office_lease_crisis_desc: Your office lease is up for renewal. The landlord wants to increase rent by 60%. The team is split on whether to renew, go remote, or find a new space.
office_lease_crisis_choice_0: Go fully remote — save the rent money
office_lease_crisis_choice_1: Negotiate aggressively — accept a small increase
office_lease_crisis_choice_2: Move to a coworking space temporarily
board_pressure_desc: Your board called an emergency meeting. Growth has slowed for 2 quarters. Two investors are pushing for a CEO change or a strategic pivot before they'll support the next raise.
board_pressure_choice_0: Present a bold turnaround plan with clear milestones
board_pressure_choice_1: Agree to hire a President/COO to share leadership
board_pressure_choice_2: Push back — defend your right to lead
data_privacy_law_desc: A new data privacy law requires users to explicitly opt-in to analytics tracking. Your conversion funnel data will drop 40% without proper UX updates.
data_privacy_law_choice_0: Full compliance immediately with proper consent flows
founder_opportunity_conference_desc: Y Combinator has invited you to their founder summit — 500 elite founders and investors for 2 days. Travel + hotel costs ~$3K. It's the best network event of the year.
founder_opportunity_conference_choice_0: Attend — every connection is potentially transformative
founder_opportunity_conference_choice_1: Attend and pitch to investors on the side
founder_opportunity_conference_choice_2: Skip — too much to do at the office
founder_health_scare_desc: After months of running on 4-hour sleep and caffeine, you collapse during a board call. Doctor says it's exhaustion-induced chest pains and orders 2 weeks of rest.
founder_health_scare_choice_1: Take 3 days off then ease back in
founder_health_scare_choice_2: Keep working from bed — too much is at stake
family_emergency_desc: A close family member is hospitalised and you need to travel urgently. The timing is rough — you have an investor meeting next week and quarterly review is due.
family_emergency_choice_0: Cancel everything and be with family
family_emergency_choice_1: Delegate to team and handle remotely
founder_therapy_desc: A mentor suggests you start seeing a therapist. Silicon Valley therapists specialising in founder burnout charge $300/session. Studies show top performers who invest in mental health outperform those who don't.
sleep_deprivation_desc: You've been averaging 4 hours of sleep for 6 weeks straight. Team members say you're irritable in meetings and making inconsistent decisions. You missed a major product bug because of it.
sleep_deprivation_choice_0: Enforce a strict 8-hour rule starting now
sleep_deprivation_choice_2: Hire a deputy to take some load off
enterprise_rfp_desc: A Fortune 500 company has sent you a 47-page RFP (Request for Proposal). They want SSO, SOC2, custom SLAs, and 99.99% uptime — things you don't have yet. Potential deal: $240K/yr.
enterprise_rfp_choice_0: Respond and promise to build the features
enterprise_rfp_choice_1: Respond honestly — offer a phased roadmap
enterprise_rfp_choice_2: Pass — too much distraction from core product
enterprise_pilot_success_desc: The 3-month pilot with TechCorp ($30K) just concluded. Their VP of Engineering says the product exceeded expectations. They want to discuss a $200K annual contract.
enterprise_pilot_success_choice_0: Push for $250K — you have leverage now
enterprise_pilot_success_choice_2: Ask for a referral to 3 other enterprises
enterprise_churn_desc: Your biggest customer ($15K MRR) has notified you of non-renewal. The reason: a competitor launched a feature you've had on the backlog for 8 months. Their migration starts in 30 days.
enterprise_churn_choice_0: Emergency feature sprint to win them back
enterprise_churn_choice_1: Negotiate a discount to retain them ($10K MRR)
enterprise_churn_choice_2: Accept the loss — focus on replacing the revenue
sales_team_miss_desc: Q3 sales target was $200K. Actual closed: $82K. Your Head of Sales blames the product — no enterprise features, slow onboarding. Product team says sales promised features that don't exist.
sales_team_miss_choice_0: Hold a joint post-mortem and fix the process
sales_team_miss_choice_1: Put pressure on sales — fire the bottom performer
channel_partnership_desc: A larger company in an adjacent space wants to resell your product to their 50K customer base for a 25% revenue share. This could 5x your distribution overnight.
channel_partnership_choice_0: Accept — distribution at this scale is rare
board_ceo_pressure_desc: Two of your board members have privately suggested bringing in an 'experienced CEO' to scale the company. They think you're great as a product visionary but question your ability to run a 50-person company.
board_ceo_pressure_choice_0: Push back firmly — this is your company
board_ceo_pressure_choice_1: Hire a COO and demonstrate you can delegate
board_ceo_pressure_choice_2: Agree to a structured CEO transition plan
board_expansion_desc: Your lead investor is insisting on adding two new board seats (their nominees) before releasing the next tranche. This would give investors majority board control.
investor_update_ghosted_desc: You've sent 3 monthly investor updates and gotten zero replies. When you call, it goes to voicemail. Then you read on Twitter they 'passed' on similar companies at your stage.
investor_update_ghosted_choice_0: Send one final direct email — ask for honest feedback
investor_update_ghosted_choice_2: Show up at their next portfolio event
gdpr_audit_desc: You've received a formal GDPR compliance audit notice from EU regulators. You have 60 days to demonstrate data handling practices. Legal fees + engineering time: estimated $25K.
gdpr_audit_choice_0: Hire a DPO and comply fully ($25K)
ip_lawsuit_desc: A patent troll has filed a cease & desist claiming your core algorithm infringes on Patent #US9,123,456. Their lawyer demands $500K or licensing fees of $50K/year.
ip_lawsuit_choice_0: Fight it — hire IP attorneys ($30K retainer)
data_breach_desc: A penetration tester (hired by a customer) found a SQL injection vulnerability. It's not exploited yet, but your entire user database is readable. You must disclose or fix quietly.
data_breach_choice_0: Disclose publicly, thank the researcher, fix it
data_breach_choice_1: Fix quietly over the weekend, no public notice
data_breach_choice_2: Blame it on a third-party service integration
employment_lawyer_desc: A former employee is suing you for wrongful termination, claiming their firing was retaliatory after they raised a workplace concern. They're asking for 3 months severance + legal costs.
employment_lawyer_choice_1: Fight it — have your legal team respond
employment_lawyer_choice_2: Settle with NDA and improved HR policies
soc2_requirement_desc: Three of your largest enterprise prospects have made SOC2 Type II certification a dealbreaker. The audit process takes 6 months and costs $30K. But it could unlock $500K+ in ARR.
soc2_requirement_choice_0: Start SOC2 immediately — the ROI is obvious
soc2_requirement_choice_1: Start with SOC2 Type I first ($15K, faster)
cto_departure_desc: Your CTO — who built the core architecture — has accepted an offer from a Series C-funded company at 3× their current salary. They're offering 2 weeks notice but own 8% of engineering knowledge.
cto_departure_choice_2: Ask them to stay for 90 days + knowledge transfer
cmo_failure_desc: 6 months in, your CMO has spent $80K on campaigns delivering minimal results. CAC is 4× your target. The team has lost confidence in marketing leadership.
cmo_failure_choice_0: Fire the CMO and hire a performance marketer
cmo_failure_choice_2: Bring in a fractional CMO instead
cofounder_burnout_leave_desc: Your technical co-founder has been showing signs of severe burnout for months. They've now asked for a 2-month unpaid sabbatical. The timing is terrible — you're 4 weeks from launch.
cofounder_burnout_leave_choice_0: Grant the leave — they've earned it
cofounder_burnout_leave_choice_1: Ask them to delay by 6 weeks
cofounder_burnout_leave_choice_2: Bring in a contractor for the gap ($15K)
well_funded_competitor_desc: Your direct competitor just closed a $20M Series A. Their job board shows 30 open roles. A VC tweets: 'This space just got serious.' Your investor calls asking for a plan.
well_funded_competitor_choice_2: Find your defensible niche — go deeper, not broader
product_copycat_desc: A team in India has shipped an identical product at 1/5th your pricing. They have fewer features but their $5/mo vs your $49/mo is already attracting your price-sensitive users.
product_copycat_choice_1: Double down on premium features and brand
product_copycat_choice_2: Name them publicly — let the community know
big_tech_entry_desc: At Google I/O, they demoed a free tool that does 60% of what you charge $99/mo for. Your Slack DMs are flooded with 'What are you going to do?' Your churn spikes 15% overnight.
big_tech_entry_choice_0: Lean into trust, compliance, and support — Google can't
big_tech_entry_choice_1: Pivot to the enterprise tier immediately
big_tech_entry_choice_2: Write a viral thread: 'Why this is actually good for us's
app_store_feature_desc: Apple's editorial team has reached out to feature your app in 'Apps We Love' across 40 countries this weekend. You have 48 hours to submit screenshots and fix any review issues.
top_startup_list_desc: Forbes just included you in their '50 Startups to Watch' list alongside names like Notion and Linear. Inbound investor interest has tripled overnight.
top_startup_list_choice_0: Write a founder perspective article riding the wave
top_startup_list_choice_1: Use it to accelerate your current raise
top_startup_list_choice_2: Stay heads down — don't let it distract the team
nps_breakout_desc: Industry average NPS is 31. Your latest survey shows 72 — exceptionally high. 3 users even emailed saying your product changed their workflow. This is a rare moment of validation.
nps_breakout_choice_0: Turn promoters into case studies and references
nps_breakout_choice_1: Interview top users to drive the next feature set
nps_breakout_choice_2: Share the score publicly + run a referral campaign
term_sheet_competition_desc: You have two term sheets on the table. Sequoia offers $5M at $20M post but wants a board seat. Tiger Global offers $5M at $25M post with no board seat but strict anti-dilution clauses.
term_sheet_competition_choice_0: Take Sequoia — the brand and advice is worth it
term_sheet_competition_choice_1: Take Tiger — higher valuation, more founder control
term_sheet_competition_choice_2: Use both term sheets to negotiate a third investor
payroll_crisis_desc: It's the 28th. Payroll is due on the 1st. Due to delayed payments from two enterprise customers, you're $40K short. You have 72 hours to find a solution.
payroll_crisis_choice_0: Take a personal loan to cover payroll
payroll_crisis_choice_1: Negotiate with employees for 2-week delay (with interest)
payroll_crisis_choice_2: Emergency revenue push — call every prospect
runway_crisis_desc: Your CFO's monthly report shows 2 months of cash left. No term sheets. Your best prospect is still in 'legal review'. The board asks for your plan in 48 hours.
runway_crisis_choice_1: Founders take no salary for 3 months
runway_crisis_choice_2: Go all-in on closing the best prospect this week
revenue_milestone_desc: You just crossed $1M ARR. The team is ecstatic. A major VC tweets congratulations. This is the moment you've been building toward for 18+ months.
revenue_milestone_choice_0: Celebrate with the team — throw a dinner
revenue_milestone_choice_1: Announce it publicly — ride the momentum
revenue_milestone_choice_2: Set a private $5M ARR goal immediately
major_server_meltdown_desc: Your primary database cluster has corrupted due to a rare race condition. Backups are 24 hours old. Your service is down, and will stay down for at least 48 hours while you reconstruct data.
major_server_meltdown_choice_0: Recover from 24h old backups — lose some data
major_server_meltdown_choice_2: Full transparency: refund everyone for the month
platform_ban_hammer_desc: A major platform (Google/Apple/AWS) has flagged your account for a Terms of Service violation. They've disabled your API access. You're effectively dead until you clear this up, which could take weeks.
platform_ban_hammer_choice_0: Fly to HQ and demand a meeting ($10K)
platform_ban_hammer_choice_1: Pivot the tech stack to avoid the platform
platform_ban_hammer_choice_2: Lawyer up and sue for anti-competitive behavior
toxic_culture_crisis_desc: A group of your top performers have been meeting in secret. They feel the company has lost its way and the culture is 'toxic'. 4 key engineers have resigned simultaneously today.
toxic_culture_crisis_choice_1: Let them go — they were 'wrong for the mission'
toxic_culture_crisis_choice_2: Promote from within and double ownership
compute_shortage_desc: The demand for H100s is insane. Your cloud provider just bumped your compute costs by 300%. Your runway is evaporating.
compute_shortage_choice_0: Pay the premium — innovation is life
compute_shortage_choice_1: Optimize models to run on cheaper hardware
compute_shortage_choice_2: Pivot to a lightweight 'Edge' AI strategy
hype_cycle_peak_desc: A major AI lab just released a paper proving your 'proprietary' method is easily replicable. Your valuation is under fire.
